tour.name: Tour
tour.description: Starting quest - automatically unlocked at the beginning of the storyline

rewards.description: Unlocks achievement Pathfinder, traders (Skier, Mechanic, Prapor, Peacekeeper), and direct access to all locations

falling-skies.name: Falling Skies

activation.summary: Ask Mechanic about the downed plane while progressing through Tour.

falling-skies.description: Investigate the crashed aircraft operation and decide what to do with the armored case.
falling-skies.notes: Keeping the armored case results in -0.3 Prapor reputation and changes The Ticket routes.

batya.name: Batya

activation.summary: Visit one of the marked BEAR trace locations on Customs, Reserve, Shoreline, or Woods.

batya.description: Investigate the Bogatyr BEAR squad, recover their trail, and coordinate with Lightkeeper and Voevoda.

the-unheard.name: The Unheard

activation.summary: Pick up and read the Purification note in one of the TerraGroup locations on Streets or Ground Zero.

the-unheard.description: Trace The Unheard's Blue Ice protocol through TerraGroup records, A.P.'s network, and encrypted data.

blue-fire.name: Blue Fire

activation.summary: Pick up and read an EMERCOM leaflet or Item 1156 note from Woods, Interchange, or The Labyrinth.

blue-fire.description: Investigate the EMP incident, secure Item 1156 intel, and follow the Rus Post lead chain.
blue-fire.notes: Planting the hacking device takes 60 seconds.

they-are-already-here.name: They Are Already Here

activation.summary: Pick up and read the Note about the Eye of the World from Customs, Reserve, Woods, or Shoreline.

they-are-already-here.description: Follow the Eye of the World trail through cultist sites, Sordi infrastructure, and ARRS Station 14-4 KORD.

accidental-witness.name: Accidental Witness

activation.summary: Locate the scribbled-over car in the Customs dormitory courtyard.

accidental-witness.description: Track Kozlov's evidence chain through Dorms, Streets, and Reshala's stash network.

the-labyrinth.name: The Labyrinth

activation.summary: Locate the Labyrinth transit in the Shoreline resort west wing basement with the Knossos key.

the-labyrinth.description: Investigate the underground Labyrinth incident, recover scientist data, and trace the missing BEAR squad.
the-labyrinth.notes: Extremely dangerous area with traps, poison hazards, and miniboss encounters.

the-ticket.name: The Ticket

activation.summary: Continue from Falling Skies after obtaining the armored case and start the Mr. Kerman terminal chain.

the-ticket.description: Branches into 4 endings based on player decisions: Savior (help Kerman), Fallen (betray Kerman), Survivor (pay Prapor), Debtor (seek Lightkeeper)
the-ticket.notes: Decision points are mutually exclusive. The armored case choice in Falling Skies affects available optional objectives (Lightkeeper access).

boreas.name: Boreas

activation.summary: Ask Mechanic about the connection between TerraGroup and Paradigm Shipping, then follow the lead to the nuclear icebreaker "Boreas".

boreas.description: Investigate Paradigm Shipping's icebreaker "Boreas", board it, and recover the hard drives from compartment C-1 for Mechanic.
